score_audit: Compare exact and incremental scores for first, last and seeded random 512 swaps in each fixture; compare earliest global minimum across all swaps.
memory: Record isolated-worker peak RSS, plus theoretical candidate-key allocation; compilation and input preparation are outside warmed timing.
selection: Use incremental if all score/winner checks pass and it is faster than chunked on the released copying fixture; otherwise use chunked. Report actual speed and memory results.
